$schema.description: Path to this JSON Schema: editor autocomplete only, ignored by the loader.

id.description: The chore id; equals the file name.

station.description: Where it is played: it must equal the `kind` of the object the level names.

windowMs.description: The base response window of a beat, in sim ms. `null`: the base window of the threats (`feel.timing.windowMs`).

verbKey.description: Key of `strings.fr.json` (`verb.` group) of the verb shown at the station while the beat is announced (« REMUE ! », story 9.5).

telegraphDelayMs.description: From the beat being announced to its window opening, in sim ms. Above the base window (`windowMs`, or `feel.timing.windowMs`), so that the ring has time to be read: checked by `content:check`.

items.description: One beat of the chore: a moment to tap the station at the right time.

beats.description: The beats of the chore, in order; each one is caught before the next is announced.

homePoints.description: Points of the Maison row of Mama’s note the chore pays once done: whole or half points (7.5), the note counts that way. An unfinished chore pays nothing.

abandonedThreat.description: Optional: what a chore left alone becomes (story 9.5: « une cuisson abandonnée plus de 30 s devient la casserole sur le feu »). Absent: leaving the chore costs nothing but the wait.

def.description: The threat the abandoned chore turns into: a file of `content/threats/` with `target: "station"`.

afterMs.description: How long the chore must stay `paused` (Papa away from the station, beats left to do) before the threat starts, in sim ms.

missBrokenObjects.description: Optional (story 9.6: « assiette cassée »): how many objects a missed beat breaks. Each one is a broken object for Mama’s Soupir (`feel.mama.sighPerBrokenPropPoints`) and a shard on the floor at the station. Absent: a missed beat breaks nothing.

missNoisePct.description: Optional (story 9.6): the noise gauge rises by this many points when a beat is missed (a crash; no effect in a level with no noise gauge). Absent: a missed beat makes no noise of its own.

openThreat.description: Optional (story 9.6: « un lave-vaisselle laissé ouvert devient une cible du bébé »): the threat of the open station, a file of `content/threats/` with `target: "anchor"`. The level plans it in a wave at the station’s anchor; the director may draw it only while the chore is paused with its door open.

telegraph.description: Cue played when a beat is announced.

success.description: Cue played when a beat is caught inside its window.

perfect.description: Cue played when a beat is caught at the centre of its window.

miss.description: Cue played when a beat is missed (the small gag of the chore).

completed.description: Cue played when the last beat is caught: the chore is done.

feedback.description: Cues of `feedback.json` › `cues` the client plays for this chore.

description: A house chore: where it is played, how many beats and how far apart, what it is worth (GDD › Tâches de la maison).
